description: This Java source file defines an immutable class ImmutablePayloadMappingDefinition implementing the PayloadMappingDefinition interface. It manages a collection of mapping definitions, provides methods for JSON serialization/deserialization, and ensures immutability. The class appears to be part of the Eclipse Ditto project relating to model connectivity payload mappings.

classes.name: ImmutablePayloadMappingDefinition
classes.description: An immutable class implementing PayloadMappingDefinition, holding a map of definition IDs to MappingContext objects, providing JSON conversion, equality, and string representation.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Creates an ImmutablePayloadMappingDefinition instance from a JSON object using ConnectivityModelFactory.

methods.name: toJson
methods.description: Serializes the definitions map to a JSON object with optional filtering.

methods.name: getDefinitions
methods.description: Returns the map of definition IDs to MappingContext objects.

methods.name: withDefinition
methods.description: Returns a new PayloadMappingDefinition with an added or replaced definition.

methods.name: isEmpty
methods.description: Checks if the definitions map is empty.
